description: For every atom set, propositional theory \(\Gamma\) and finite formula \(C\), \(\Gamma\models C\) if and only if \(\Gamma\) derives \(C\) by a finite proof in the specified classical natural-deduction calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.strong_completeness.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryEntails Γ C ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryDerives Γ C
